name: ABB ACS355 embedded fieldbus (Modbus RTU)
doc_revision: ACS355 user's manual 3AUA0000066143 (Manualzilla copy; the page text cites 'Rev A' for the fault-tracing chapter; ABB's own library copy https://library.e.abb.com/public/805f31a82d524d8aa8a750011e2cd001/EN_ACS355_UM_E_A5.pdf could not be fetched (over 10 MB) and was NOT read). Chapter 'Fieldbus control with embedded fieldbus' and 'Actual signals and parameters'.
notes: Built from the Manualzilla copy of the ACS355 user's manual, read through a summarising fetch in 100k-character segments; NOT verified on a physical drive. Addressing: the manual numbers registers 4xxxx and states 'Register 4xxxx is addressed as xxxx -1' in the Modbus message (40002 -> 0001). Therefore address_base = 1 and each 'address' is the printed 4xxxx register number. Mapping per manual: 40001 control word (ABB drives profile), 40002 Reference 1, 40003 Reference 2, 40004 status word, 40005-40012 Actual 1..8 (selected by parameters 5310-5317; their defaults were not captured), 40031-40034 DCU-profile words (not included). 40101...49999 are drive parameters 0101...9999 (e.g. 40102 = parameter 0102; parameter 5302 = register 45302). Supported function codes per manual: 03, 06, 08 (subcodes 00, 01, 04), 10 (hex), 17. Parameter writes through Modbus are volatile; parameter 1607 PARAM SAVE stores them (manual). Scaling (FbEq) per the manual's actual-signal tables: 0103 1=0.1 Hz, 0104 1=0.1 A, 0105 1=0.1 %, 0106 1=0.1 kW, 0107 1 V, 0109 1 V, 0110 1=0.1 C, 0114 1 h, 0115 1 kWh. uint16/int16 choice is not stated by the manual for most signals; only 0101 (negative = reverse) is declared signed here. Reference scaling per manual (ABB drives profile): REF1 20000 = 100% = parameter 1105 (max speed/frequency); REF2 10000 = 100% = parameter 1108; both limited by parameters 1104/1105 and 1107/1108. Allowed REF min/max were not captured, so none is enforced. ABB drives profile control word (par. 5319 shows it in hex) bits: 0 OFF1 CONTROL, 1 OFF2 CONTROL, 2 OFF3 CONTROL, 3 INHIBIT OPERATION, 4 RAMP_OUT_ZERO (ABB DRV FULL only), 5 RAMP_HOLD, 6 RAMP_IN_ZERO, 7 RESET, 10 REMOTE_CMD (ABB DRV FULL only), 11 EXT CTRL LOC. Status word (par. 5320) bits: 0 RDY_ON, 1 RDY_RUN, 2 RDY_REF, 3 TRIPPED, 4 OFF_2_STA, 5 OFF_3_STA, 6 SWC_ON_INHIB, 7 ALARM, 8 AT_SETPOINT, 9 REMOTE, 10 ABOVE_LIMIT, 11 EXT CTRL LOC, 12 EXT RUN ENABLE. The exact control word values that start/stop the drive (state machine) were not captured; do not guess them. SAFETY: 40001/40002/40003 (group 'control') command a real motor (start/stop/speed). They are rw because the manual lists them R/W; they only act when the drive is configured for fieldbus control (EFB, group 53/10/11 parameters). NOT captured/unclear: default values of 5302 station ID, 5303 baud rate (rates 1.2-115.2 kbit/s), 5304 parity (the extract suggests 8 NONE 1 but this is not explicit) and 5305 profile; fault code tables; 5310-5317 default mappings; PI/other groups. Parameter-group registers 45302-45307 are marked read-only here as a precaution although the manual says parameters are writable through Modbus.
